{{Top|leg}}
'''Gravity treadmills''' were exercising machines, used for walking or running while staying in the same place. One such model was the [[GRGC-800]].

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
[[File:Grav_Mill.png|thumb|Two Grav Mills in ''Tiny Death Star'']]
The [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]], better known as the [[Death Star/Legends|First Death Star]], had a couple of grav mills at the [[Workout Center]] for its residents to use.
{{Noncanonend}}
